title: Setup permission-set editor: no Export column, so `allowExport` cannot be seen on the set, and the Assigned Users panel covers the object grid (at 390 px no object row is visible)
body:
Filing gate **① a product defect with a reproduction**. Found by the HotCRM full browser pass objectstack-ai/hotcrm#2320 on `@objectstack/*` 18.2.0: track 5 Setup (report comment 6442758420 on objectstack-ai/hotcrm#2320, finding D4, D8; screenshots on branch `claude/project-thread-ptkrz3` under `qa/` and in the HotCRM project files `qa-2320/5-setup/`). Filed by the `repo:hotcrm` seat (`huangyiirene`, session `session_01J8VVAnPkgK6CWrJa6t7Fk5`), which re-read each finding against its screenshot. Batch-of: hotcrm#2320 platform findings.

`finding` class **a** · `reach:` public door: the console on `@objectstack/*` 18.2.0, measured in Chromium against the HotCRM seed.

## What is seen

1. **No Export column.** Setup → Permission Sets → `sales_rep`: the grid has C R U D Tr VA MA, read and write scope and Bulk; no Export column, and expanding a row shows field rows only. HotCRM's `sales_rep` grants export on `crm_case` (the server answers `GET /api/v1/data/crm_case/export` 200), and the position page's summary of the same set shows `E` (`14-permset-sales-rep.png`, `15-permset-sales-rep-case-expanded.png`, `13-position-service-manager.png`).
2. **The panel covers the grid.** At 1440×900 about 5 object rows fit between the legend and the pinned Assigned Users panel, and the Bulk column and field count are cut off at the right; at 390×844 no object row is visible at all, and "Only granted" and the read-only banner are clipped (`14`, `16-permset-sales-rep-field-overrides.png`, `80-admin-05-setup-permset-detail-phone.png`).

**Who loses:** an admin auditing who can export data cannot see it on the set that grants it; on a laptop the page's main content is mostly hidden.

## Expected

The editor shows every axis the set carries, Export included (as the position summary does), and the Assigned Users panel does not overlay the grid (collapsible, or below it on narrow widths).

## Dedupe

`search_issues` objectstack "permission set editor export column allowExport assigned users panel overlaps grid": 4 hits — #26720 (open, spec docs say admin sets grant export), #21229, #3544, #3710 (closed, export axis and grid options). None is the editor's missing column or its layout.

**Reader who acts:** the console Setup permission-set editor owner (`domain:ui`).
